title: Port Build 7 ECR -1 to Build 8: Depart test not perfomed well
executive_summary: This change fixes a bug where the departure test shows as Failed even though no new test was performed after a previous pass. The core issue is that when a 1010 non-controlling command arrives during the Begin Departure Test prompt, the test result is incorrectly reported as Failed. You need to run L2R26:TC1, L2R26:TC2, and L2R35:TC1 which directly test this scenario—they cover the exact sequence described in ECR-1. Also run TC-5010, TC-5017, and TC-5011 to verify brake pipe pressure preconditions still work correctly (L2R1234). The change affects 9 components including Departure Test Module (RCMP-002), Brake System Interface (RCMP-003), and Back Office Interface (RCMP-009). Critical gap: L2R26, L2R720, L2R615, and L2R1644 lack direct test run evidence despite being affected by this change.

ecr_overview.title: Port Build 7 ECR -1 to Build 8: Depart test not perfomed well
ecr_overview.description:
When onboard is Displaying Begin Departure Test prompt, resulting by pressing Init key, and when 1010 is sent to go non-controlling, onboard is displaying Depart test as Failed

Scenario
-Make sure Depart test is passed
-Enable Depart flag (Toggle Brake interface from EBI)
-begin Initializing
-send 1010 "Command locomotive system state to Non-controlling" at Begin Depart Test prompt
-Press Depart test key at cutout and observe 2011 report
Observe Depart test shows depart test report as Failed even though no departure test is performed after prvious depart test is passed

sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.body: This change fixes a bug where the departure test shows as Failed even though no new test was performed after a previous pass. The core issue is that when a 1010 non-controlling command arrives during the Begin Departure Test prompt, the test result is incorrectly reported as Failed. You need to run L2R26:TC1, L2R26:TC2, and L2R35:TC1 which directly test this scenario—they cover the exact sequence described in ECR-1. Also run TC-5010, TC-5017, and TC-5011 to verify brake pipe pressure preconditions still work correctly (L2R1234). The change affects 9 components including Departure Test Module (RCMP-002), Brake System Interface (RCMP-003), and Back Office Interface (RCMP-009). Critical gap: L2R26, L2R720, L2R615, and L2R1644 lack direct test run evidence despite being affected by this change.
